messages:
mike: Noticed p99 spike on GQA path after we switched to interleaved KV layout. Repro: seq=512 batch=8 model=13B A100. Baseline p99~110ms -> now ~130ms.

sarah: Yikes. Did autotuner change kernel choice? paste the selector trace if you have it.

mike: Autotuner picked a smaller-block kernel. Condensed trace:
```
kernel_selector -> paged_attn_interleaved_b128
latency p50=40ms p95=78ms p99=131ms
kv_layout=interleaved block=128 prefetch=32
```
Baseline (row-major b256):
```
kernel_selector -> paged_attn_row_b256
latency p50=36ms p95=70ms p99=109ms
kv_layout=row-major block=256 prefetch=48
```
So different kernel + layout correlates with regression.

julia: Interleaved should help MQA, but for GQA we might be breaking the access pattern. Our scoring currently assumes row-major stride for kv. Autotuner likely mis-ranked kernels.

kevin: Microbench results on devbox (single A100):
```
./bench_attn --kernel paged_attn_row_b256 --seq 512 --batch 8 -> 36.5ms
./bench_attn --kernel paged_attn_interleaved_b128 --seq 512 --batch 8 -> 45.2ms
```
Confirms interleaved kernel slower here.

sarah: Proposal: add layout_factor to tuner scoring. latency_est *= layout_penalty(layout, block, prefetch).

julia: Also include prefetch_distance and eviction_locality in the sweep. We should collect kv-miss-rate and prefetch_thrash metrics so the tuner learns penalties.

mike: I'll spin up perf sweep perf/kv-layout-grid/1998765433 that varies layout={row,interleaved,paged}, block={64,128,256}, prefetch={16,32,48,64}, seqlen={64,128,512,1024}, batch={1,4,8}. Will pull kv-miss-rate, eviction_trace, and kernel timings.

perf-bot: started job perf/kv-layout-grid/1998765433

kevin: Note: some v2 kernels use aggressive prefetching tuned for big-block row layouts; with interleaved small-block they overfetch and thrash. Might need to tune prefetch per-layout or disable for small-block interleaved.

julia: Interim mitigation: selector rule - if layout==interleaved and seqlen>=512 prefer block>=256 or fallback to row-major compatible kernel. I'll draft a conservative heuristic and add as canary flag.

mike: I'll add the heuristic and roll to canary cluster tomorrow AM. Kevin please run targeted e2e once it's up.

kevin: Will do. If leaning to fallback, we should track rollback criteria: p99 reduction >10% and no reg elsewhere.

mike: Agreed. Will post sweep summary and canary results here.

sarah: Great. Also open a follow-up to make the kv_stride estimator layout-aware long-term.

mike: Filed PERF-2981 with initial notes. Linking in next message.
